notes: costs.lvlN is cost from N-1 to N for one talent; sum current+1 through target. Only multiply by three if all three talents share the range.
Traveler forms have separate dataset entries. Traveler normal-attack costs may differ by element; do not treat one supplied table as proof for all three Traveler talents.
The stats endpoint supplies combat stats, not character EXP.
XP remaining = sum(levelExp[current…target-1]) - current XP. Mora for books consumed is supplied XP / 5. Show overflow and ascension milestones.
Scope this planner to levels 1–90 and count selected books rather than estimating farming days.
Provider has no release-status field; this is a community snapshot, not proof that every listed record is released.

EXP overflow is lost at ascension milestones. For a range crossing 20/40/50/60/70/80, calculate each segment separately; do not just ceil the total EXP/book size. 1→90 with Hero’s Wit only requires 421 books across milestones, while naive total ceiling gives 419. Mixed-book example is provided per segment.
